// ==UserScript==
// @name         Pinterest Dark (Polished)
// @namespace    https://gist.github.com/KillaMeep/c5e8506a7c32169843d0373f710dfb02
// @version      0.1
// @description  Nicely styled dark theme for Pinterest (toggle with Shift+R)
// @author       KillaMeep
// @match        https://*.pinterest.com/*
// @match        https://pinterest.com/*
// @match        http://*.pinterest.com/*
// @match        http://pinterest.com/*
// @icon         https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?sz=64&domain=pinterest.com
// @grant        none
// @run-at       document-start
// ==/UserScript==

(function() {
  'use strict';
  console.log('Pinterest dark userscript initializing (KillaMeep)');
  const DARK_CSS = `
:root{ --bg: #0b0b0f; --panel:#111315; --muted:#9aa0a6; --text:#e6e6e6; --accent:#e60023; }
html.dark-by-userscript, body.dark-by-userscript { background: var(--bg) !important; color: var(--text) !important; }
html.dark-by-userscript *{ background-color: transparent !important; color: inherit !important; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.06) !important }
html.dark-by-userscript header, html.dark-by-userscript nav, html.dark-by-userscript footer, html.dark-by-userscript [data-test-id="app-root"] { background: var(--panel) !important }
html.dark-by-userscript a, html.dark-by-userscript a * { color: var(--accent) !important }
html.dark-by-userscript img, html.dark-by-userscript video, html.dark-by-userscript svg { filter: none !important; background: transparent !important }
html.dark-by-userscript input, html.dark-by-userscript textarea, html.dark-by-userscript select, html.dark-by-userscript button { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02) !important; color: var(--text) !important; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.04) !important }
html.dark-by-userscript .pin, html.dark-by-userscript .BoardGrid, html.dark-by-userscript article { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.45), rgba(0,0,0,0.3)) !important }
html.dark-by-userscript *{ transition: background-color .12s linear, color .12s linear, border-color .12s linear }
`;

  const LS_KEY = 'pinterest_dark_enabled_v1';
  let __pd_enabled = true;
  try {
    const ls = localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY);
    if (ls === 'false') __pd_enabled = false;
  } catch (err) { /* ignore storage errors */ }

  const ensureStyle = () => {
    try {
      if (!document.getElementById('dark-by-userscript-style')) {
        const s = document.createElement('style');
        s.id = 'dark-by-userscript-style';
        s.textContent = DARK_CSS;
        const parent = (document.head || document.documentElement);
        parent.appendChild(s);
        s.dataset.injectedAt = Date.now();
        console.log('Pinterest dark userscript: style injected');
      }
      if (__pd_enabled) {
        if (!document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark-by-userscript')) {
          document.documentElement.classList.add('dark-by-userscript');
          console.log('Pinterest dark userscript: class added');
        }
      } else {
        if (document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark-by-userscript')) {
          document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark-by-userscript');
          console.log('Pinterest dark userscript: class removed (user disabled)');
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Pinterest dark userscript: injection error', err);
    }
  };

  // Retry a few times during page load in case the head/body are replaced by the SPA
  let __pd_attempts = 0;
  const __pd_maxAttempts = 12;
  const __pd_interval = setInterval(() => {
    ensureStyle();
    if (++__pd_attempts >= __pd_maxAttempts) clearInterval(__pd_interval);
  }, 500);

  // Apply as early as possible
  ensureStyle();

  // Keep it applied across SPA navigations
  const observer = new MutationObserver(() => ensureStyle());
  observer.observe(document.documentElement || document, { childList: true, subtree: true });

  // Keyboard toggle: Shift+R
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    try {
      const ae = document.activeElement;
      const tag = ae && ae.tagName;
      const isEditable = ae && (ae.isContentEditable || ['INPUT','TEXTAREA','SELECT'].includes(tag));
      if (isEditable) return; // don't toggle while typing
      if (e.shiftKey && (e.key === 'R' || e.key === 'r')) {
        __pd_enabled = !__pd_enabled;
        try { localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY, __pd_enabled ? 'true' : 'false'); } catch (err) { /* ignore */ }
        if (__pd_enabled) {
          document.documentElement.classList.add('dark-by-userscript');
          console.log('Pinterest dark userscript: enabled by user');
        } else {
          document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark-by-userscript');
          console.log('Pinterest dark userscript: disabled by user');
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Pinterest dark userscript: toggle error', err);
    }
  });
})();
